hero.lead: Proprietary origination, documentary verification and end-to-end management of each asset through to exit.
hero.location: Palma de Mallorca · Operations across the Balearic Islands, Catalonia, Cantabria and Andalusia.

position.label: Position
position.trackRecordText: Closed operations with deeds; detail and returns in the verification document.

thesis.label: Thesis
thesis.line1: The operations with the most upside
thesis.sub: Discretion is not opacity. It is method.
thesis.situations: debt, successions, portfolio divestments and land with planning management pending.
thesis.assets: residential for repositioning, fully zoned land and entire buildings.

steps.title: Origination
steps.text: Deal flow arrives through our own network, never through a listing.

steps.title: Verification
steps.text: Title, charges and actual condition, checked against official sources.

steps.title: Valuation
steps.text: Price is defended with transaction data, not adjectives.

steps.title: Allocation
steps.text: Each asset is shown only to mandates where it fits.

steps.title: Execution
steps.text: NDA, due diligence and completion, fully traceable.

portfolio.label: Portfolio
portfolio.title: Two closed. Two available.
portfolio.intro: The two most recently closed operations — bought and sold, with deeds — and the two currently available to mandates. The full perimeter under management (seven operations · 117 registered units) is documented in the data room, under NDA.

infrastructure.label: Infrastructure
infrastructure.title: A proprietary platform, in development for over seven years.
infrastructure.intro: It connects origination, analysis and document access. Each project has its own library of verified documents, protected and fully traceable.

features.title: Invitation only
features.text: Every account is opened by Althara. No public sign-up.

features.title: Digital NDA
features.text: One signature unlocks the confidential documentation.

features.title: Protected documents
features.text: Time-limited links and a personal watermark on every download.

features.title: Fully traced
features.text: Every view and download is logged.

partnerships.label: Partnerships
partnerships.title: Althara also operates as infrastructure for third parties.
partnerships.p1: Originators, agencies and wealth advisers use analysis, documentation and process under their own brand. The client stays with the partner.
partnerships.p2: Each access runs on isolated infrastructure.

research.label: Research
research.researchText: Proprietary research on regulation and markets. Launch piece: price-limited housing in the Balearics, public version only.
research.verificationText: Every published figure is defined, dated and signed. The closed track record — with deeds — and its returns sit in the verification document.
research.governanceText1: Investment, finance, tax and legal integrated into operations, each with over thirty years of track record. Semi-annual review and versioned methodology.

access.label: Access
access.sub: Every request receives an answer within 24 hours, one way or the other.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.intro: This page defines the figures the firm publishes in its visible layer. It covers those figures only. No return figures are published on this site.
methodology.s2intro: The figures correspond to a perimeter of {operations} operations and {units} registered units, with the following composition:
methodology.s2note: The firm operates in Cantabria; the figures on this page exclude Santander as it is not counted in the perimeter. Counted perimeter: {operations} operations.
methodology.s3text: The value of assets under project management is calculated on acquisition value plus investment executed on the asset. It does not incorporate unrealised market revaluation or any leverage effect.
methodology.s4text: The return methodology lives in the verification document, with the explicit clarification that the asset universe (live operations) and the return universe (closed operations) are not the same. The per-operation breakdown, including the worst performer, lives in the data room.
methodology.s5text: No change is edited in place. Every update produces a new dated version — v1.1, v2.0… — and the history remains accessible.

contactModal.title: Access request

verification.label: Verification document
verification.title: Every published figure is defined, dated and signed.
verification.intro: The verification document is issued by the sole director and sets out, for each figure published on this site, what it measures precisely, the universe it is calculated on, and the documentary support with which it would be evidenced on request.
contains: Definition of each published figure and its cut-off date.
Calculation universe for each one, including the return methodology.
How each is evidenced: deeds, registry extracts, accounts and certificates.
